title: First mechanisms
goal: Polar and radical steps on the four example reactions.

problemSets.title: Polar steps
problemSets.conceptInOneLine: A lone pair or a π bond attacks an electrophile; a leaving group takes the pair.
problemSets.conceptCard:
Each curved arrow moves **one pair** of electrons.

Start the arrow at the electrons, not at the atom.

setItems.whyThisOne: One concerted step: attack and loss together.
An enolate forms, then adds to a carbonyl.

problemSets.title: Radical chain
problemSets.conceptInOneLine: Fish-hook arrows move one electron each.
problemSets.conceptCard: A bond broken evenly needs **two** fish-hooks.

problemSets.title: Checkpoint
problemSets.conceptInOneLine: Which kind of step is this?
problemSets.conceptCard: The names are hidden until you finish.
